scope: Owner-requested October 23, 2026 welcome hero for the Arc page: a short greeting, one line on the import, and the Sunrise Spectrum app icon. The import claims rest on public v1.42.1; the app icon line is an owner waiver until a release ships the icon.

arcImport.qualification: User-selected local sidebar import, not a live connection or account migration. Each selected Space becomes a Blanc Space; loose pins remain pinned and folders become groups. Optional top-row Favorites go to the Arc folder. No sign-ins, passwords, history, archived tabs, Notes or Easels. Linux requires a copied sidebar file. Real-sidebar hand checks do not establish Intel Mac or x64 Windows acceptance.

appIcon.qualification: Sunrise Spectrum is a macOS-only app icon choice merged to main in #1069 (39ecfd3a7) and not yet in a public release. On Windows and Linux there is no app icon choice.
